User analytics helps you learn how users engage with your products, experiences, and campaigns so you can make them better. Get instant answers Answer complex questions in seconds. Non-technical users can use simple reports for segmentation, retention, and funnels quickly and easily. Surface automatic insights Uncover trends in your data automatically. Complement your analysis and discover the best actions to take in less time with machine learning and advanced statistics tools. Take intelligent action Act on your findings through Mixpanel or 3rd-party tools. Automatically trigger messages, A/B tests, and personalization, then measure the downstream results—all in one place. "Mixpanel enables DocuSign to be successful because it enables our customers to be successful. What started as a need for simple marketing metrics turned into custom product metrics for over 100 different stakeholders across the company." Drew Ashlock - Product Manager, DocuSign “Using Mixpanel to instrument new workflows, we’ve made significant improvements to multiple user flows. In one instance, we ended up doubling the conversion of new users to first-time bill payers.” Director - Product Management, Intuit “The ability to select subsets of events, and then divide them out by country or game or whether the users are logged in: it’s simply incredible.” Emmett Shear - CEO, Twitch, an Amazon company "In just 30 days, we gained deep insight into where our users are going and what to build next. I can rely on Mixpanel’s team—they deliver in every way!" Fortune 100 Media & Entertainment Company "Because of Mixpanel's Funnels, Segmentation, and Notification tools, we're more proactive in preventing and resolving issues."
